meta.title: Relocation at Revolut
meta.description: Take your career to the next level, while immersing yourself in the vibrant culture, rich history, and marvellous lifestyles of Poland, Portugal or Spain. Join us in redefining the fintech world!

content.title: Relocation with Revolut
content.description: Looking for opportunities overseas? Join our team of software engineers and data scientists in Poland, Portugal, or Spain. Unlock your potential, explore new horizons, and step into the future of FinTech.

content.title: Make your move
content.description: Hear from Revoluters — Saurabh, Tatiana, and Yahia — on how they took their careers to the next level after relocating.

content.title: Our hubs
content.description: Dive into diverse cultures and discover dynamic tech communities. You'll work remotely or in a hybrid format in our offices in Kraków, Porto, Lisbon, Barcelona, or Madrid.

items.title: Our hubs
items.description: Dive into diverse cultures and discover dynamic tech communities. You'll work remotely or in a hybrid format in our offices in Kraków, Porto, Lisbon, Barcelona, or Madrid.
items.caption: Our hubs

items.title: POLAND
items.description: Buzzing with innovation and opportunities, Poland's tech community is the place to drive progress. And for those days off, discover the vibrant cities of Warsaw and Kraków, or explore the outdoors at the Tatra Mountains.
items.caption: Poland

items.title: PORTUGAL
items.description: Portugal offers professional growth and a rich culture. Where tradition meets tech, and innovation thrives. There’s plenty to do too, from the sun-kissed beaches of the Algarve and the scenic Douro Valley, to the lively streets of Porto and Lisbon.
items.caption: Portugal

items.title: SPAIN
items.description: From technology to history, art to cuisine, Spain's got it all. The vibrant tech scene combines new ideas with opportunities for development — and why not get inspired by the architectural innovation of Barcelona and Madrid?
items.caption: Spain

items.title: Choose your career
items.description: Our engineers and data scientists are at the forefront of FinTech, reshaping the industry landscape and pioneering change.
items.caption: Choose your career

items.title: Software engineering
items.description: Engineers operate with the freedom to innovate and think big. We believe in the potential of every team member's ideas to make change. Our agile eXtreme programming approach ensures rapid, high-quality software delivery.
items.caption: Software engineering

items.title: Data science
items.description: Our data scientists have a clear insight into the business, collaborating with key stakeholders, and impacting strategic decisions. Data drives our real-time systems, from personalised products and fraud prevention, to customer satisfaction.
items.caption: Data science

items.title: Eligibility criteria
items.description: Mid-to-senior level professionals can benefit from our programme, with the final seniority to be determined after technical interviews. Applicants should have 5+ years of production experience.
items.caption: Eligibility criteria

content.title: Calling all engineers
content.description: Is it time for a new challenge? Join the team and discover where it takes you

items.title: Self-led determination
items.description: Our engineering team functions like a startup, enjoying the freedom to innovate independently.

items.title: Think big, act bold
items.description: Big ideas meet founder-led actions. We're never afraid to push boundaries.

items.title: Relentless innovation
items.description: We strive for excellence, from building the best products to streamlining proccesses.

items.title: Be the backbone
items.description: Engineering is the foundation of all that we do. We see it as the powerhouse of product creation.

items.title: Drive forward together
items.description: We work in a collaborative environment, where we design, build, test, and develop with a shared vision.

content.title: Ready to join the team?
content.description: Explore eligible opportunities to relocate, and what it takes to become part of our tech team.
content.caption: Careers

content.title: How do we help you?
content.description: Moving to a new city or country can be overwhelming. That’s why we’re there every step of the way, ensuring things are as smooth as possible. It's not just support for you — it's for your spouse and children, too.

items.title: Flights to the country you're moving to

content.title: What you'll get
content.description: We care about your career journey, offering opportunities for growth, development, as well as top-tier benefits.

items.title: Compensation
items.description: Attractive compensation level and stock options.

items.title: Insurance
items.description: Medical insurance for you and your close ones.

items.title: Flexible work
items.description: Flexibility to work from home, the office, or abroad.

items.title: Revolut Metal
items.description: A complimentary Revolut Metal plan loaded with benefits.

items.title: Socials
items.description: Exciting events year-round so you can get to know your team.

To find out more about which Revolut entity you receive services from, check our corresponding FAQ page. If you have any other questions, reach out to us via the in-app chat in the Revolut app.

Revolut Bank UK Ltd is registered in England and Wales (Registered No. 12871051). Registered address: 30 South Colonnade, London, E14 5HX. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and Prudential Regulation Authority (Financial Services Register No. 981170).

Revolut Ltd is registered in England and Wales (No. 08804411), is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority to offer e-money and payment services under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 (FRN: 900562), and is registered with the Financial Conduct Authority to offer cryptocurrency services under the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017. Commodities services are provided by Revolut Ltd and are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Investment services are provided by Revolut Trading Ltd (No. 11567840), which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN: 933846).

The registered address of Revolut Ltd, Revolut Travel Ltd, and Revolut Trading Ltd is at 30 South Colonnade, London, United Kingdom, E14 5HX. You can read more about our terms and policies here.
